rendering_pipeline.render_path: 2D digital gongbi illustration, layered flat mineral-pigment washes over fine ink outline underdrawing; simulated silk/rice-paper substrate
rendering_pipeline.antialiasing: sub-pixel vector line smoothing on outline strokes
rendering_pipeline.tone_mapping: art-directed flat value separation (no filmic curve); 4-5 stepped ink-wash value bands

key_light.type: soft diffused skylight through canopy (painterly, no hard cast shadow)

shadows.type: flat graded ink-wash shadow (painterly, no real-time shadow map)

god_rays.technique: hand-painted soft crepuscular shafts through dark tree canopy, frame_05/frame_06 only

fog.type: layered atmospheric mist (aerial perspective in shan-shui style)

water.wave_technique: none; lower edge reads as misted rock water-edge but is atmospheric wash, not a simulated water plane

particles.name: floating luminous spores / petal motes
particles.motion_type: gentle upward buoyant drift in wind

camera_composition.projection: orthographic flat illustration plane (no perspective distortion)

motion.type: extremely slow push-in / parallax between 3-shot sequence

composition.type: figure-and-beast diagonal grouping with large canopy negative space

qiyun_shengdong.evidence: frame_01/02 woman's long black hair flows and merges seamlessly into the white horse mane; frame_05/06 veil and hair stream in one continuous wind gesture across the frame — breath/qi made visible.

gufa_yongbi.evidence: frame_01/02 precise gongbi outline on horse muzzle, mane strands and ginkgo leaf veins; frame_03/04 leopard spots and branch twigs drawn with controlled iron-wire lines; frame_05/06 fine contour on veil folds.

yingwu_xiangxing.evidence: frame_01/02 accurate equine anatomy and fan-shaped ginkgo leaf; frame_03/04 leopard feline musculature and paw form; plants rendered with botanically legible silhouettes.

suilei_fucai.evidence: frame_01/02 layered mineral teal wash on robe, cinnabar-orange coral branches as sparse accent; frame_05/06 amber light painted as flat warm block against deep indigo shadow — color assigned by category in classic heavy-color (zhongcai) manner.

jingying_weizhi.evidence: frame_01/02 figure-beast group occupies lower diagonal, canopy leaves frame upper right; frame_03/04 leopard and figure anchored left-third, misty mountain void to right; deliberate blank/negative space (liubai) balances dense foliage.

chuanyi_moxie.evidence: inherits Song-dynasty gongbi bird-and-beast tradition and shan-shui atmospheric mist; modern digital brushwork and anime-proportioned faces (frame_05/06) update the lineage rather than copy a specific master.

effect_to_library_mapping.library: unreal exponential height fog + painted depth haze
unreal exponential height fog + volumetric material

effect_to_library_mapping.effect: soft glow on spores and amber light

motion.camera_motion_type: slow parallax push-in across three vignettes (woman+horse / woman+leopard / close-up veil)
